_note: Magic parity fixture (01-09): four independent scenarios exercising castSpell (a damage spell in a forced encounter, and a heal outside combat), drinkPotion, and readScroll. Seeds were found by a throwaway discovery script (engine-only, cross-checked for prototype parity before being committed here — same method 01-05/01-07/01-08 used) that scanned seeds 1-5000 via newRun(seed) for a Magic User whose rolled grimoire/scrolls made each scenario reachable at level 1: seed 8 is an Illusionist with Freeze in its grimoire (a lvl-1 offense spell, thrown kind); seed 7 is a Wizard with Heal in its grimoire and a scroll on hand. `castSpell` requires an `idx` field (the spell's index into content/spells.js's SPELLS array, matching engine/actions.js's castSpell.idx validation); `drinkPotion`/`readScroll` take no extra fields. `startCombat` is not in engine/actions.js's validated ACTION_TYPES (an internal function other rule domains call) -- see test/parity/combat-parity.test.js's header for why the harness special-cases it.
